summary: USS Fairview (EPCER-850) was a United States Navy PCE(R)-848-class Patrol Craft Escort (Rescue) that served from April 1944 to May 1968. The note highlights that the ship was present at the surrender of Japan in Tokyo Bay at the end of World War II.
one_line: USS Fairview (EPCER-850) was a US Navy patrol craft escort (rescue) in commission from 1944 to 1968, present at Japan's surrender.
key_facts: USS Fairview was a United States Navy PCE(R)-848-class Patrol Craft Escort (Rescue).
USS Fairview was in commission from April 1944 to May 1968.
USS Fairview was present at the surrender of Japan in Tokyo Bay at the end of World War II.
